name: Shan-Loong Transportation Co.,Ltd
summary: Shan-Loong Transportation Co., Ltd. is a diversified enterprise operating across Taiwan and internationally, specializing in various services including freight movement, container haulage, vehicle maintenance, fuel sales, and import/export activities. The company provides a comprehensive range of transportation solutions, covering containers, bulk goods, fuels, and hazardous materials. Its robust logistics division offers extensive services, such as container loading and unloading, comprehensive warehouse management, order processing, temperature-controlled storage, last-mile delivery, and reverse logistics, in addition to general handling, picking, and processing operations. Shan-Loong also facilitates customs brokerage, manages global shipping via sea, air, and land, and provides dedicated product storage management. Beyond its core logistics and transport offerings, the company operates a network of 76 gas stations, which dispense fuels like diesel and octane, along with offering vehicle cleaning services for cars and scooters. Founded in 1976 as Wang Pai Transportation Co., Ltd., the company rebranded to Shan-Loong Transportation Co., Ltd. in 1982 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
